results.name: candidate readback preserves raw legacy sources and does not activate until promotion
complete authored state saves and previous immutable revision remains recoverable
competing tabs compare-and-swap; exactly one same-revision writer wins
abort after write request success does not acknowledge save or move active pointer
interrupted verification leaves staged candidate recoverable but non-activatable
aborted activation is atomic and verified candidate can subsequently be promoted
stale candidate cannot replace an intervening save; stale activation token cannot save into a new project
injected quota failure remains explicit and retains previous active revision
quota thrown inside a request callback aborts save and promotion without an uncaught exception
versionchange closes cached connection and incompatible reopen fails instead of hanging
legacy helpers distinguish missing/failed reads and wait for set/clear transaction completion

limitations: Disposable IndexedDB harness; external/API and service workers blocked. Not full App, provider, native, physical/assistive or performance acceptance.
